CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `emailUnsubscribes` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `userId` int NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `emailType` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `token` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `unsubscribedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `resubscribedAt` timestamp DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `eu_token_idx` (`token`),
  KEY `eu_userId_idx` (`userId`),
  KEY `eu_email_idx` (`email`)
);
